caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of two main parts: a flat, wooden platform, which is medium brown with visible grain, and a metallic blade attached beneath it. The metal blade is dark, showing rust and weathering, and has a curved shape, curling upward into a prominent hook at the rear end. The wooden platform is contoured to fit over the metal, with two rectangular slots visible on its side, possibly for fastening. There is also a small vertical metal peg or nail protruding from the front section of the wooden platform. The drawing is bordered by a simple, thin rectangular outline. The signature "Saim Freeman" and the notation "D 370-1" are written in the bottom right corner of the white space surrounding the drawing.
title: Ice Skate
